---
name: my-skill
description: Use when building any page for Chai Khana, a late-night chai and paratha spot in Gulberg, Lahore for students and night-shift workers who want a warm, hand-drawn, slightly nostalgic 90s-PTV feel.
---

1. Brand name is Chai Khana. Tagline is "Doodh patti till sehri." Voice is a friendly Lahori uncle: short lines, warm, never corporate. Use "aap" in English transliteration where it fits ("aap ka order").
2. Primary colour #6B2E1F (deep karak brown). Accent #F4C430 (haldi yellow). Background #FFF8EC (cream). Text #2A1810. Never use pure white or pure black.
3. Headings in "Fraunces" from Google Fonts, weight 700. Body in "Inter", weight 400. Prices in "JetBrains Mono" so they line up in the menu.
4. Every page includes a sticky top bar with the logo on the left and a phone-shaped CTA on the right reading "Order on WhatsApp". Every page ends with a footer showing the Gulberg address, opening hours (6pm to 6am), and a single Instagram link.
5. The home page needs a hero with the tagline, a signature-items strip of three cards, an about paragraph under 60 words, and a contact section.
6. Prices are written as "Rs. 180", never "180 PKR" or "180/-". Dates read as "25 Nov" or "Thursday night". Phone numbers show the 11 digits with one space after the first four: "0300 1234567".
7. Menu items sit in a grid of cards. Each card has one food emoji, a name, a one-line description under eight words, and the price in the bottom-right.
8. Images use rounded corners of 12px and a subtle 2px cream border. Buttons are fully rounded pills with a 1px brown border on hover.
9. All body copy stays under a reading width of 65 characters. Line height is 1.6 for body, 1.1 for headings.
10. Never use stock photos of smiling models holding mugs. If a real photo is missing, use a hand-drawn SVG illustration in the brand brown instead.
